headlines.text: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83/share, raising $81.3B in the largest offering on record, as ANT shares prepare to begin trading on Nasdaq near a $1.5T valuation
Nvidia and global chip stocks — Micron, SK Hynix, ASML — rally in premarket trading as Anthropic's blockbuster IPO revives AI-trade confidence, snapping Nvidia's five-session losing streak
Trump, Xi and Putin hold their first-ever trilateral meeting at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, with Ukraine, trade and AI-chip export curbs on the agenda
Fed's Oct. 28 minutes show almost all officials favoring further rate hikes, with Waller alone pushing for a supersized 50bp move at the December meeting
Initial jobless claims rise to 203,000 for the week ending Nov. 14, above the ~197K-208K consensus range, as the four-week average ticks up to 197,750
Walmart tops Q3 estimates with $188.8B in revenue and $0.65 adjusted EPS, raising its full-year outlook on strength from affluent shoppers
Brent crude holds near $92 as Hormuz tanker threats offset a looming supply glut and hawkish Fed rate-hike bets
